posts.cooked:
Screenshot 2025-09-24 224234884×280 6.03 KB

I’m repeating the course this term where as I’m unable to access the VM and kept showing access denied.
Also i retook the login process again but the .pub file is not generated

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Please follow the steps properly. If you upload your public key on the website, you will be able to login.

posts.name: Ashish Augustine
posts.cooked:
Yes followed as stated .Yet, to access the public key the .pub file should be generated , right ?
Also i had done my BPT’s in the previous term via VM and yet still permission denied even though i used the same password.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: The .pub file will be created if the steps are followed correctly, you might be missing some step. I would recommend fixing this as soon as possible. You can join a TA session and get this clarified.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Follow this -

OR

You can simply do cd .ssh on powershell & there check the public key

image835×401 7.23 KB

The one with .pub is the file whose contents you need to copy
